title: Stock count shown after checkout is sometimes one too high

fingerprint.symptom: stock count on the order summary is sometimes one higher than the real stock
fingerprint.trigger: reading available() right after checkout of one unit
fingerprint.expected: count reduced by the units just bought

bisect.reason: bisect is unreliable for intermittent failures

root_cause.summary: checkout reads available() for the summary before the reservation write has finished, so the count is sometimes read from before the write.

locations.reason: the summary is built without awaiting the reservations

root_cause.fix_direction: Await every reservation before building the order summary.
root_cause.ide_prompt:
Fix GitHub issue #10 in this repository.
Reproduction test: test/reprise/issue-10.test.js (get it with: git checkout origin/reprise/repro-10 -- test/reprise/issue-10.test.js).
Run it with: node --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=/out/junit.xml test/reprise/issue-10.test.js. It currently fails with: AssertionError: expected available 4, got 5
Likely cause: checkout reads available() for the summary before the reservation write has finished, so the count is sometimes read from before the write.
Locations: src/cart.js lines 33–36
The first bad commit was not searched: the failure is intermittent.
Rules: do not modify test/reprise/issue-10.test.js; keep the change minimal; run the full suite with node --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=/out/junit.xml test/ before finishing; open a PR whose description contains "Fixes #10".
